text:
alice (sec): Hey team — prepping KMS audit evidence for SOC2. Need a consolidated mapping + queries for AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and Azure Key Vault. Also need: envelope-encryption event indicators, RBAC/change events that affect keys, and key-rotation records. Anyone got playbook snippets or examples we can reuse? cc @ella (compliance) :wave:

ben (sre): I have a CloudWatch Logs Insights query we used last quarter for KMS activity. Useful as a starting point.
```
fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.keyId, awsRegion, sourceIPAddress
| filter eventSource = \"kms.amazonaws.com\" and eventName in (\"Encrypt\", \"Decrypt\", \"GenerateDataKey\", \"GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext\", \"ReEncrypt\")
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 500
```

claire (eng): For GCP we pulled from Cloud Audit Logs / BigQuery with this filter. Note resource type and protoPayload paths differ from AWS.
```
resource.type = \"kms_crypto_key\"
protoPayload.methodName:(\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Encrypt\" OR \"Decrypt\" OR \"CreateCryptoKeyVersion\" OR \"UpdateCryptoKeyVersion\")
| jsonPayload = protoPayload
| select timestamp, jsonPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, jsonPayload.request.name, jsonPayload.methodName
```

dmitri (infra): Azure has annoying field names but this KQL worked for us in Log Analytics:
```
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == \"MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT\"
| where OperationNameValue in (\"Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/keys/wrap/action\", \"Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/keys/unwrap/action\", \"Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/keys/create\", \"Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/keys/rotate/action\")
| project TimeGenerated, OperationNameValue, Caller, Identity, ResultType, ResultDescription, Resource
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
```

alice (sec): Nice — can we also list what to look for as evidence of envelope encryption vs direct key use? Short summary would help auditors.

ben (sre): Envelope indicators: you will see GenerateDataKey or GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext (AWS) being called by your service principal. The pattern is: service calls GenerateDataKey, gets ciphertext data key (stored with resource), then uses local data-key to encrypt payload; only KMS sees the key ops. So logs show the API calls but never the plaintext.
- GCP: CreateCryptoKeyVersion / Encrypt calls on the key ring resource; sometimes services call AsymmetricSign/Decrypt depending on scheme.
- Azure: WrapKey / UnwrapKey operations show wrapping of DEKs.

ella (compliance): For the audit we need: sample events (CSV), counts per operation, timeline range, and RBAC change evidence (who changed a role on KMS resource and when). Prefer packaged bundle with a small manifest.

claire (eng): RBAC events mapping:
- AWS: CloudTrail events like \"PutRolePolicy\", \"AttachRolePolicy\", \"UpdateAssumeRolePolicy\" and specifically \"PutKeyPolicy\" for KMS key policy changes. Also track IAM console activity via CloudTrail consoleSignIn + ChangeEvents.
- GCP: methodName \"SetIamPolicy\" on the cryptoKey resource (protoPayload.authorizationInfo shows permission and principal).
- Azure: \"MICROSOFT.AUTHORIZATION/ROLEASSIGNMENTS/WRITE\" or OperationNameValue containing \"Write Role Assignment\" in AzureDiagnostics.

ben (sre): Example minimal manifest we ship with evidence bundles:
```
{
  \"bundle_id\": \"evidence_kms_2026-03-10_az1\",
  \"collected_at\": \"2026-03-10T15:20:00Z\",
  \"sources\": [\"aws/cloudtrail-kms.csv\", \"gcp/kms-logs.jsonl\", \"azure/keyvault-diagnostics.csv\", \"rbac/rbac-changes.csv\"],
  \"notes\": \"Filtered to KMS API surface and IAM/RoleAssignment changes. Includes sample events and counts by operation.\"
}
```

alice (sec): Good. Any gotchas re: retention/aggregation? We need to include proof that logs were retained and not truncated for the window.

dmitri (infra): Make sure to export CloudTrail to an S3 bucket with MFA delete + bucket access logs. Capture the delivery times and the bucket object list. For GCP, export audit logs to a BigQuery dataset or GCS; include dataset ACLs and retention policy. For Azure, diagnostic setting -> storage account/Log Analytics workspace — capture the diagnostic setting config and the storage access logs.

ella (compliance): Also we need to show that key rotation policies were enforced or manual rotations performed. Examples of evidence:
- AWS: CloudTrail events for \"DisableKey\", \"EnableKeyRotation\", and any \"ScheduleKeyDeletion\" or \"CancelKeyDeletion\". Also the key metadata: KeyRotationEnabled flag snapshot.
- GCP: CreateCryptoKeyVersion + DestroyCryptoKeyVersion events (versions create/disable).
- Azure: Key rotation operations and KeyRotationPolicy updates in diagnostic logs.

claire (eng): Quick note: automated rotation for AWS managed keys isn't logged as an API call every year (auto-rotation is a state on the key). We should fetch DescribeKey and record KeyRotationEnabled and last rotation timestamp if available, plus any CreateCryptoKeyVersion events in GCP.

infra-bot: evidence-bundle-creator: Generated preliminary bundle s3://redwood-audit/evidence_kms_2026-03-10_az1.zip (contains cloudtrail-kms.csv (500 rows), gcp-kms-logs.jsonl (420 rows), azure-kv-diagnostics.csv (380 rows), rbac-changes.csv (45 rows)).

alice (sec): Perfect — I'll review the bundle and redact any PII, then upload to the auditor drive. Thanks everyone :pray:

ben (sre): If helpful I can add a small notebook that recreates counts + operation breakdowns from the CSVs.

ella (compliance): Yes please — include a readme with the queries used and a short summary table (ops, count, first_ts, last_ts). That's what the auditors ask for.

alice (sec): Action items: ben -> add notebook and query docs; dmitri -> export storage/delivery proof and retention configs; claire -> GCP key-version snapshot; ella -> confirm audit window. I'll assemble by EOD Friday.

claire (eng): noted.

alice (sec): closing thread once bundle is in drive. Thanks all! :rocket:
